title: finding(app-shell): `detectConditionWidget` requires a string arm, but every SERVED metadata predicate key derives without one — the generic condition builder may mount for no served type at all
body:
Blocked-by: objectstack-ai/objectstack#19295

Dedup keywords: `detectConditionWidget` · `ExpressionInputSchema` · anyOf string arm · condition builder never mounts · `meta/types` served derivation

Surfaced by the `os-dev` on objectui#9791, which stopped on a falsified remedy premise and reported this instead of widening its card. ⛔ Unassigned and ungraded. Class **(c)** on its face — a predicate an author can write that the runtime then refuses — but the population claim wants triage's own reading, so both halves are separated below by **who measured them**.

## Half 1 — the mechanism. Verified at source by the `domain:ui#2` seat, ⛔ not inherited

`packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/SchemaForm.tsx:591-599`:

```
function detectConditionWidget(name, schema) {
  if (Array.isArray(schema?.enum)) return undefined;
  const isString =
    schema?.type === 'string' ||
    (Array.isArray(schema?.anyOf) && schema.anyOf.some((b) => b?.type === 'string'));
  if (!isString) return undefined;
  if (CONDITION_FIELD_NAMES.has(name) || /When$/.test(name)) return 'condition';
  return undefined;
}
```

⇒ the CEL condition builder is routed **only** when the property's JSON Schema is `type: 'string'` or carries an `anyOf` arm typed string. The name convention alone is **not** sufficient — `isString` gates it first. Read at `SchemaForm.tsx:591`, ⛔ not from a report.

## Half 2 — the population. The dev's measurement, ⛔ NOT re-derived by this seat

Measured against the **installed** `@objectstack/spec` 17.4.0, by the same `z.toJSONSchema` call objectstack serves `/meta/types` with:

- every predicate key the dev could find — `hook.condition`, `sharing_rule.condition`, flow `edge.condition`, page/action nav `visible`, `field.visibleWhen` / `readonlyWhen` / `requiredWhen` — is `ExpressionInputSchema`, a union **whose string arm is a transform, so the OUTPUT derivation erases it**, leaving an anyOf of an empty schema plus the ADR-0089 envelope object — **no string arm**;
- `action`, the one type served from the authoring retry arm, derives `visible` / `disabled` as anyOf boolean-plus-anything — also no string arm.

⇒ if both halves hold, `ConditionWidget` mounts for **no served type at all**, and the two pin tests that exercise it pass only because they **declare a bare `type: 'string'` predicate key themselves**.

⚠️ **Residual uncertainty, stated by the dev rather than hidden:** a different backend, or a form spec pinning `widget: 'condition'`, would change the answer; no such pin was found in spec or in this repo outside a test. ⇒ ⛔ this seat does not assert Half 2 as settled — it is a reading to reproduce, and the reproduction recipe is in the dev's report on objectui#9791.

## Why this is class (c) if it holds

The affected keys' runtimes **fail-CLOSE** on an unevaluable predicate (objectql's rule validator binds `{ record, previous }` and rejects the write; the hook tier likewise). ⇒ an author writing a condition on such a surface gets **neither the builder nor any lint**, and the record is refused at evaluation time. That is metadata written by one party and rejected by the runtime that consumes it.

## ⚠️ What it would mean for a ruling already in force

objectui#8167's director ruling (`5716922008`) pins a seven-row table mapping metadata type to lint scope, and `ResourceEditPage` derives from it. ⭐ If the builder never mounts for a served type, then the **generic-form arm of that ruling is dark in production today** — the table is correct and pinned, and the surface it governs is not reached. ⛔ That is a reading for the **director seat**, ⛔ not an edit: the table's values are ruled, and this card ⛔ does not propose changing them.

⚠️ Note the one measured exception the ruling's own implementation relies on: objectui#8167's landed edge pin mounts `ResourceEditPage` for a `hook` and DOES observe the engine's verdict — but it supplies the `/meta/types` schema row as a **fixture** with `condition` typed string. ⇒ that pin does not contradict Half 2; it is a hand-written schema of exactly the kind Half 2 says is the only thing that reaches the widget.

## Options the dev laid out, ⛔ none chosen here

1. **File and let the director seat decide** whether `detectConditionWidget` should learn the ADR-0089 envelope shape.
2. Treat it as **spec-side**: have `/meta/types` serve the authoring (io input) derivation — ⚠️ which objectstack's own `toJsonSchemaSafe` header records as proposed, measured, and **deliberately REFUSED** as a published-contract weakening. ⇒ ⛔ that arm is not freely available.
3. Do nothing; accept the generic builder is reachable only for hand-written schemas.

## Dedup

⛔ Not run — filer attaches the words, triage runs them. Keywords at the top.

---

## 维护者速读

元数据设计器要为一个字段挑一个编辑控件。它从服务端拿到的那个字段的「形状」有时是空的(`{}`),而空形状在 JSON Schema 里**同时**表示两件相反的事:「什么都收(包括字符串)」和「这个变换把自己的输入类型擦掉了」。⇒ **objectui 从它被服务的文档里分不出这两者**,所以它只能一律否决,作者就拿不到条件构建器。

交付物 ① 已经落地(PR objectui#9911:五份复制粘贴的判断收敛成一个具名 `admitsString()`)。剩下的这一半**不可能由本仓推出**,必须由**声明面**回答。

**问:A 让键名压过无信息的形状;还是 B 给「擦除族」一个标记,让消费端分得出来?**(两条路都 ⛔ 不回滚已交付的 ①)

| 选项 | 做什么 | 代价 |
|:--|:--|:--|
| **A 名字压过形状** | 形状为 `{}` 时不再否决,按键名(`condition` / `visibleWhen` / `readonlyWhen` / `requiredWhen`)直接给条件构建器 | ⚠️ 擦除族的真实类型未知 ⇒ 构建器可能配在一个并不适用的键上,而**没有任何东西会报错**;且这等于宣布「`{}` 读作 admits-string」,而承接席的消融②**已经反向 pin 住**了这一点 ⇒ 选 A 必须同笔改那条 pin |
| **B 给擦除族一个标记** | 在 ADR-0089 信封上加一位(或等价手段),让消费端把「擦除」与「什么都收」分开;标记落地前 objectui 维持现状 | 协议面改动,要走 objectstack 的发布与兼容流程;短期内作者仍需在 form spec 里显式钉 `widget` |

⚠️ 第三条路(全局把服务 authoring 派生成 `io: 'input'`)**已被上游量过并明确拒绝**,而且有一条会变红的 pin 守着(`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.meta-types-degenerate-derivation.test.ts:19-28`:24/26 个类型在 `input` 下答案不同,方向是**削弱已发布契约**)⇒ ⛔ 路已关,不在选项里。

## 四棱

- **① 项目长远合理性**:B 让**声明面**成为唯一真相,消费端只读一位;A 把一条推断规则**复制到每一个消费端**,而且推断依据是键名而不是类型。按①:B。
- **② 实际业务拉动**:今天作者**有门可走**——form spec 里显式钉 `widget` 是三层优先级的第一层,今天就生效。⇒ 拉动真实但**不紧急**,②允许 B 走完整流程。
- **③ 防 AI 犯错**:A 的失败是**静默的**(控件配错、无人报错);B 给出的是**机器可读的区分**,失败方向是响亮的。⇒ B。
- **④ 创业阶段不扩散**:A 新增一条永久的、隐式的命名约定义务(每个消费端都要记住它);B 新增一位显式声明。两者都在扩,但 B 的义务在**一处**,A 的在**每处**。⇒ B。

⛔ **The `Prior rulings read:` line published here earlier was run in the WRONG REPO's checkout, and this seat is correcting it in place.** (Corrected at 2026-09-18T20:35Z, clock read by this write.) `check-prior-rulings.mjs` has no `--repo` flag by design — its own docblock says 「the CORPUS is always THIS checkout … so a flag naming a different board would read a card from one repo and answer it out of another repo's rulings, **with nothing in the output saying so**」 — and this seat ran it from the objectstack checkout and pasted the answer onto an objectui card. Measured: objectui's `docs/adr/` holds **0001, 0034, 0036, 0053–0059** only; **ADR-0021, ADR-0029 and ADR-0061 do not exist in this repo** (they do in objectstack, control run in the same command). Both readings, labelled:

- **Prior rulings read (THIS repo, objectui — `AGENTS.md` + `docs/adr/**`)**: `widget` / `detection` / `naming convention` → **54 hits** across `AGENTS.md` and `docs/adr/0001`, `0036`, `0054`, `0056`, `0057`.
- **Prior rulings read (objectstack's corpus — the shared protocol's rulings, relevant where this card touches the contract, ⛔ NOT this repo's numbering)**: widget,detection,naming,convention → 11 hits; ADR-0021 D3, ADR-0057 D11, ADR-0057 D7, ADR-0076 D9, ADR-0128 D1, ADR-0129 D4, ADR-0131 D9

**推荐:B**(给擦除族一个标记),回退项 **A**。自检:「只看①选 B;②③④ 是否翻转:**否**——②只说明它不急,③④ 同向。」⭐ 这是本席自己按四棱推出的,⛔ 不是沿用分诊席的意见(分诊席明确未选)。

**置信缺口**:本席**未量**服务端到底有多少个键落在「擦除族」里,也**未量**在 objectstack 的发布/兼容流程里加这一位要多久。⇒ 若那个数很小且流程很长,A 的成本账可能翻过来——而这正是维护者视角里本席看不见的那部分。

**裁后执行**:裁 B ⇒ 在 objectstack 立一张协议卡(spec 车道收口),objectui 侧本卡转 `pm:blocked` + `Blocked-by:` 指向它;裁 A ⇒ 一张 `domain:ui` 卡,同笔改那条把 husk 边界钉成否决的 pin,并在卡上写明「`{}` 自此读作 admits-string」。

<sub>四棱块由 `domain:ui#2` 执行席在本卡进决策箱后补齐(2026-09-18T18:38Z);⛔ 本席不改级别、不改路由,⛔ 也不代裁。分诊席的转箱裁定见评论 `5732633489`,交付物 ① 的落地验证见 `5732717032`。</sub>
